title: Compare photons by color
statement:
Which photon is more energetic, one at 460 nm or one at 610 nm?

[_]{a}

explanations: The frequency and energy are higher.
This treats energy as increasing with wavelength.
Brightness alone does not set the energy per photon.

hints: Both wavelengths use the same unit.
Energy is hc divided by wavelength.
The shorter wavelength gives larger energy.
solution: Both wavelengths use the same unit. Energy is hc divided by wavelength. The shorter wavelength gives larger energy. The frequency and energy are higher.
